# - The SHA-512 instructions (FEAT_SHA512, Armv8.2 optional) of
#   zfs_sha512_block_armv8 (module/icp/asm-aarch64/sha2/sha512-armv8.S, its
#   .Loop_hw). sha512_impl.c selects that implementation only when
#   zfs_sha512_available() finds ID_AA64ISAR0_EL1.SHA2 = 2 (the SPL reads it
#   at load: cpu_features0); QEMU's cortex-a76 and the Q8B's cores report 1
#   (SHA-256 only) and use the generic C code.
.Loop_hw	isa	sha512h.2d
.Loop_hw	isa	sha512h2.2d
.Loop_hw	isa	sha512su0.2d
.Loop_hw	isa	sha512su1.2d

# - Data, not code: .LK256 and .LK512 are the SHA-256 and SHA-512 round
#   constants, which sha256-armv8.S and sha512-armv8.S keep in __text after
#   their functions; llvm-objdump decodes some words as SVE, SME and Armv9
#   instructions only with every feature on.
